description: Every repository extends it with `github>dougborg/renovate-config` and adds only its own rules.
Every manager Renovate enables by default stays on, proto and mise included; pre-commit is turned on as well.

packageRules.description: Every update is `chore(deps)`, overriding config:recommended's `fix` type for production dependencies, so each commit passes the eleven-type commit lint as written.
One pull request per manager for non-major updates.
One pull request for every GitHub Actions update, majors included, as the Dependabot baseline did.
